note: Transforms never read gold, trap signatures or validator findings.
noteExtensions: S, R and X choose what to change only by structural position, a status enum value and a seed; they never read gold, trap signatures, lexicons, validator findings or item text. Gold is read only by the frozen scorer and to split results by family.

definitions.+X: the policy followed by X(r = 1) of the X family (boundary resets; every interviewSignalRisks, humanReviewChecklist and limitations item deleted)
definitions.drop_note_cited: relabel every supported-side item whose source ids include a note-class source of its case
definitions.drop_note_or_unsourced: drop_note_cited plus every supported-side item without a source id (the drop_unsourced set)

sourceTypePolicyDesign.reads: case metadata candidate.evidence[].sourceId / sourceType (which source ids are notes) and the sourceIds / sourceId field of each supported-side item; never gold, trap signatures, lexicons, validator findings or item text

xGridDesign.order: S(p, mode) then R(q) then X(r); at p = 0 the two modes coincide and are listed once as mode 'none'
xGridDesign.seedsPerConfig: 3 when any of p, q, r is strictly between 0 and 1, else 1 (the transform is then deterministic)
